programme.desc: During the aggression on Ukraine, Russian soldiers killed more than 400 Ukrainian athletes. Russians destroyed hundreds of stadiums, sports centers, gyms, and pools. Thousands of young athletes and children fled war to foreign countries. Exactly two years after the start of the Russian attack on Ukraine, the film "Character: Sportsman" assesses the impact of the war on Ukrainian sports, athletes, and sports infrastructure.

programme.title: Fight and dance (Борись и танцуй), Biografinis, Istorinis, Karinis, Ukraina, 2025
programme.desc: On April 13, 2025, Russian forces launched an Iskander missile strike on the center of the city of Sumy. The attack killed 35 people and injured another 127. In terms of civilian casualties, it was the deadliest attack on the city throughout Russia's war against Ukraine. That day, Viktoriia Rudyka was walking through the city with her daughters, Kira and Elina. The missile exploded just a few meters away from them. Despite a long period of medical treatment and the loss of her husband in the war, the family remained in Sumy. The girls practice ballet, which has become a form of rehabilitation for them. Their small scooters, shattered by shrapnel and stained with blood, have since become a symbol of the tragedy. Thirteen-year-old Kyrylo Iliashenko, who was also wounded that day, managed to open the door of a burning bus and saved the lives of many people. Just one month after the tragedy, he won a silver medal in beach wrestling at the European Championship. Kyrylo continues to train and dreams of one day competing in the Olympic Games.

Atsiveria durys, ir gimsta galimybės. Dokumentinis serialas "Pionieriai" - tai pasakojimas apie du krepšininkus: lietuvį Šarūną Marčiulionį ir ukrainietį Aleksandrą Volkovą. Po kelių valandų jo pėdomis pasekė ir lietuvis Šarūnas Marčiulionis. Tą dieną A. Volkovas NBA rungtynėse sužaidė tik vieną minutę, tačiau ta minutė tapo istorine. LRT TELEVIZIJOS naujienų tarnyba turi plačiausią korespondentų tinklą visoje šalyje, todėl operatyviai gali informuoti iš kone bet kurios Lietuvos vietos. Čia ir naujausia teisinė informacija, medicinos, kultūros naujienos, neakivaizdžios kelionės po išskirtines pasaulio vietas ar patyrusio virtuvės šefo pasiūlyta idėja vakarienei.
